lines.en: label wakanaspring2:
scene clearnightsky
The rest of the day dies off without putting up much of a fight.
lines.zh: 这一天剩下的时间没怎么挣扎就死掉了。

lines.en: I spent most of it lounging around with Imani, talking about how school has been for her and how misery has been for me.
lines.zh: 我大部分时间都跟 Imani 一块儿闲着，聊她那边学校过得怎么样，聊我这边过得有多惨。

lines.en: Not much has changed on either end.
lines.zh: 两头都没什么变化。

lines.en: It’s kind of funny, really — how all of the girls in class like to tell me about how {i}different{/i} things are without me but, at least according to her, everyone’s more or less the same.
lines.zh: 说真的挺可笑的——班上的女孩们总爱跟我说，没有我的时候一切有多{i}不一样{/i}；可按她的话说，大家其实都差不多。

lines.en: The loud ones are still loud, the quiet ones are still quiet. The smart ones are still smart and the weird ones are still weird.
lines.zh: 吵的还是吵，安静的还是安静。聪明的还是聪明，古怪的还是古怪。

lines.en: I guess that word encompasses most of the class, though.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得「古怪」这个词大概涵盖了班上大多数人。

lines.en: I miss them sometimes. But it’s diluted by the fact that I can visit them whenever I want {i}outside{/i} of school.
lines.zh: 有时候我想她们。但这种想念被稀释了——因为{i}校外{/i}我想见她们随时都能见。

lines.en: It’s a terrible dilution, really — like mixing ammonia into bleach, where it’s hard to realize just how dangerous it really is until it’s already too late.
lines.zh: 那种稀释其实很糟糕——就像往漂白水里掺氨水，等意识到它到底有多危险时，往往已经太迟了。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk1
Something’s up with Wakana and Osako.
lines.zh: Wakana 和 Osako 之间有事。

lines.en: I can see it now that it’s been pointed out.
lines.zh: 一经点破，我现在能看出来了。

lines.en: They’re good at hiding it, though. Which is why I’m thankful for Imani since she swooped in and told me before I had to force it out of Wakana.
lines.zh: 不过她们很会掩饰。所以我很感激 Imani——她抢在我不得不去逼问 Wakana 之前就主动告诉了我。

lines.en: She might look strong, but it’s all a facade. I realized that the day she broke down in my arms just minutes before I told the girls I’d be leaving them for a little while.
lines.zh: 她看着坚强，可那全是假象。我是在她崩在我怀里的那天明白过来的——就在我跟女孩们说要离开一阵子的前几分钟。

lines.en: All things considered, I probably could have noticed sooner. And I probably should have listened when everyone told me she actually {i}likes{/i} me.
lines.zh: 说起来，我本该更早察觉的。而且大家都说她其实是{i}喜欢{/i}我的，我本该听进去。

lines.en: I’m not sure why she is the way she is, but there’s still a {i}lot{/i} I don’t know about her. And that’s fine. I don’t need to know everything.
lines.zh: 我不确定她为什么会是这个样子，但我不了解的她还有{i}很多{/i}。这也没关系。我不必知道一切。

lines.en: But I can’t stop looking at her tonight — and it’s not because of her bathing suit.
lines.zh: 但今晚我忍不住一直看她——而且不是因为她的泳衣。

lines.en: I just don’t want her to be sad.
lines.zh: 我只是不想让她难过。

lines.en: She’s too good for such feelings, though. And it’s doubtful they’ll ever reach her in the first place when the pedestal I’ve placed her on is so high up that I’d need a rocket just to get there.
lines.zh: 不过那种情绪配不上她。何况我给她搭的神坛高到我得坐火箭才够得着，那些情绪大概一开始就没法触及她。

lines.en: They’ll work it out, I think.
lines.zh: 她们会解决的，我想。

lines.en: They’re adults.
lines.zh: 她们是成年人。

lines.en: They’re adults and they’re in love. Or at least what we all see as love when I’m sure it’s more complicated than that.
lines.zh: 她们是成年人，而且她们相爱。或者说，至少在我们所有人眼里算是爱——但我敢肯定它远比那复杂。

lines.en: The way each of them struggles to hold eye contact with one another for more than a second is the only hint I need right now.
lines.zh: 她们两人连维持一秒钟以上的眼神接触都做不到，这是我此刻唯一需要的线索。

lines.en: But again, that’s fine — because {i}my{/i} eyes are on her, even if they aren’t meant to be. And she won’t go unnoticed.
lines.zh: 不过这也无所谓——因为{i}我的{/i}目光在她身上，哪怕这目光本不该落在那儿。而我不会让她无人看见。

lines.en: For tonight, though, the way I’ll stare is different.
lines.zh: 不过今晚，我看她的方式不一样。

lines.en: For tonight, I’ll silently acknowledge how important to me she is.
lines.zh: 今晚，我会默默承认她对我有多重要。

lines.en: But in the morning, I’ll forget...
lines.zh: 但到了早上，我会忘掉……

lines.en: Because this is the most miserable I’ve ever seen her — and I don’t want that memory to remain. Nor do I want the image of that fake smile ingrained into my mind because I {i}know{/i} it’s all just hope and booze.
lines.zh: 因为这是我见过她最惨的样子——我不想把这段记忆留下。我也不想让那个假笑刻进我的脑子，因为我{i}知道{/i}那全是靠希望和酒精撑起来的。

lines.en: And yes, Osako looks sad too...but more defeated than anything.
lines.zh: 没错，Osako 看起来也难过……但更多的是垂头丧气。

lines.en: Wakana, though-
lines.zh: 而 Wakana——

lines.en: : Hey...has anybody ever told you guys how fuckin’ {i}HOT{/i} you are?
lines.zh: : 嘿……有没有人跟你们说过，你们他妈有多{i}性感{/i}？

lines.en: I feel like Wakana might get lost at sea the second I stop looking at her.
lines.zh: 我觉得只要我不再看着她，Wakana 下一秒就会迷失在海上。

lines.en: : All the time...Osako and I were actually voted the most attractive couple in college....Isn’t that right, Osako?
lines.zh: : 经常有人说……我和 Osako 当年在大学里还被票选为最般配的一对呢。对吧，Osako？

lines.en: : It’s not. Senior superlatives aren’t really a thing once you get out of high school.
lines.zh: : 没有这回事。高中一毕业，「毕业班之最」这种东西就不流行了。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk2
: I ever tell you guys I actually won one of those things?
lines.zh: : 我跟你们说过我其实拿过一个吗？

lines.en: : Not that I can remember. Which is good, because the people who brag about those things years later are the same ones who peaked in high school and have to live the rest of their lives in a constant decline.
lines.zh: : 我不记得你说过。这是好事，因为过好多年还在炫耀这种东西的人，就是那种把高中当人生巅峰、余生只能一路走下坡的家伙。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk3
: Girl, why you gotta do me like that?...
lines.zh: : 姐妹，你干嘛这么对我？……

lines.en: : I won a few of those actually. {i}Most likely to win an Olympic medal...Most likely to travel the world...{/i}
lines.zh: : 其实我拿过好几个。{i}最有可能拿奥运奖牌……最有可能环游世界……{/i}

lines.en: : And also {i}best smile.{/i}
lines.zh: : 还有{i}最佳笑容{/i}。

lines.en: : Best smile? Really?
lines.zh: : 最佳笑容？真的假的？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk4
: Why do you sound so surprised?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛一副很惊讶的样子？

lines.en: : Osako used to get these cute little dimples in her cheeks when she was younger. Now, they only come out once in a blue moon. How sad.
lines.zh: : Osako 年轻的时候脸上会有两个很可爱的小酒窝。现在难得才露一次。真让人伤感。

lines.en: : That one just...didn’t fit in with the other two, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那个嘛……大概跟另外两个不太搭。

lines.en: : The fuck, man? I just won class clown.
lines.zh: : 操，老铁？我拿的可是「班级活宝」。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk5
: And I won {i}absolutely{/i} nothing because I went to a prestigious private school where only the best of the best were enrolled.
lines.zh: : 我可是{i}啥都没{/i}拿到，因为我读的是名校，只收尖子里的尖子。

lines.en: : So what you’re saying is that you’re the...worst of the best?
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，你是……尖子里最差的那个？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk6
: Uhhhhhhhh fuck you. I’d rather win nothing at all than be voted a clown by a jury of peers. Also, fuck you again.
lines.zh: : 呃————去你的。我宁可什么都没拿到，也不想被一帮同龄人票选成小丑。还有，再去你一次的。

lines.en: : Damn, I just got fucked twice in the same line.
lines.zh: : 卧槽，同一句话里我被操了两次。

lines.en: : First two times in seven years, {i}bitch.{/i} You can thank me later.
lines.zh: : 七年来的头两回哦，{i}贱人{/i}。以后谢我。

lines.en: : Wakana, how drunk are you? I’ve never seen you speak like this before.
lines.zh: : Wakana，你到底喝了多少？我从没听你这样说过话。

lines.en: : I’m not drunk, I’m {i}high.{/i} Alcohol has no effect on me. But apparently taking it with this new medication {i}does.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我没醉，我是{i}嗨{/i}了。酒精对我不起作用。显然配着这新药吃就{i}有作用{/i}了。

lines.en: : I {i}did{/i} tell you not to do that.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}跟你说过别这么干。

lines.en: : Now we know for next time. And hey, if I wind up in the hospital again, maybe Arakawa will actually come visit me this time, you fucking {i}douche.{/i}
lines.zh: : 下次就知道了。嘿，要是我又进了医院，也许荒川这回真会来看看我了，你这个操蛋的{i}混球{/i}。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk7
: Ay! Don’t go calling my senpai a douche! He’s awesome and great and kind and I’m only sorta mad that he hasn’t boned me yet!
lines.zh: : 喂！别管我前辈叫混球！他超棒、超好、超温柔，我只不过有点气他到现在还没把我睡了！

lines.en: : Arakawa, you had all day and you {i}still{/i} haven’t screwed Imani? What were you even doing? Playing cards?
lines.zh: : 荒川，你有一整天的时间，居然{i}还{/i}没把 Imani 办了？你到底在干嘛？打牌？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk8
: Oh! We should play cards! We should play a drinking game!
lines.zh: : 哦！我们应该打牌！我们应该玩喝酒游戏！

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk9
: We should play the King’s Game!
lines.zh: : 我们应该玩国王游戏！

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk10
: That game...does not involve cards, Imani.
lines.zh: : 那个游戏……不用牌，Imani。

lines.en: : {i}And{/i} there’s no point in playing it when we already know I’m the fucking {i}queen.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且{/i}反正大家早就知道我才是那个{i}王后{/i}，玩它也没意义。

lines.en: : Don’t care! Let’s play!
lines.zh: : 不管！来玩嘛！

lines.en: : How? We don’t have chopsticks either.
lines.zh: : 怎么玩？我们连筷子也没有。

lines.en: : Beats the fuck outta me. Senpai, let’s go collect seashells and then you can, like...hold them in your hand or something and let us try to pick the big one. I don’t know! I want to play!
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道。前辈，我们去捡贝壳吧，然后你……把贝壳攥在手里什么的，让我们试着挑出那个最大的。我不知道啦！我就是想玩！

lines.en: : I never should have given you two half of my beers.
lines.zh: : 我压根不该把一半啤酒分给你们俩。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk11
: I vehemently disagree.
lines.zh: : 我坚决不同意。

lines.en: : Wait a second — half of the first batch or half of the batch we went and picked up afterwards? Because I gave Wakana a couple of mine the first time but then quickly learned my lesson and stopped.
lines.zh: : 等等——是第一批次的一半，还是我们后来又买的那批的一半？因为我第一次给了 Wakana 几瓶我的，但很快就吸取教训停手了。

lines.en: : Yes. Well, you’re a much better learner than I am. And I also didn’t realize it was even possible for her to get like this.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你的学习能力比我强多了。而且我之前都不知道她还能变成这样。

lines.en: : King’s Game! King’s Game! King’s Game!
lines.zh: : 国王游戏！国王游戏！国王游戏！

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk12
: Why do you want to play the King’s Game so badly? Why not play something we actually have the materials for?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛这么想玩国王游戏？为什么不玩个我们真的有道具的？

lines.en: : Because even though I’m half-Japanese, I’ve never gotten to play! I was deprived of all the quirky and fun Japanese drinking games and had to play shit like {i}Stump{/i} instead! It’s not fair!
lines.zh: : 因为虽然我有一半日本血统，我却从来没玩过！那些古灵精怪又好玩的日本喝酒游戏全没我的份，我只能玩什么「{i}敲树桩{/i}」之类的破玩意儿！不公平！

lines.en: : What the hell is {i}Stump?{/i}
lines.zh: : 「{i}敲树桩{/i}」到底是什么鬼？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk13

: Okay. So there’s this stump, right? And everybody gets a nail. And there’s a hammer, right? So you, like, flip the hammer, okay? But the hammer’s gotta hit somebody else’s nail. And if it does, boom. Take a shot.
lines.zh: : 好。是这样的：有个树桩，懂吧？然后每人发一根钉子。还有一把锤子，懂吧？然后你把锤子翻转出去，明白吗？但锤子必须砸到别人的钉子。砸中了，砰——喝一杯。

lines.en: : But then you’ve {i}also{/i} gotta drink if you try to flip the hammer and you miss it, so your hand-eye shit’s gotta be {i}on,{/i} you hear me? Oh, and if the nail gets fully hammered in-
lines.zh: : 但你要是翻转锤子没砸中，{i}也{/i}得喝，所以你的手眼协调能力得{i}在线{/i}，听懂没？哦，还有，如果钉子被完全砸进去——

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk14
: I want to play truth or dare!
lines.zh: : 我想玩真心话大冒险！

lines.en: : Hey! I ain’t done talkin’ about {i}Stump!{/i}
lines.zh: : 嘿！我还没讲完{i}树桩{/i}呢！

lines.en: : I dare Akira to kiss Imani!
lines.zh: : 我敢 Akira 亲 Imani！

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk15
: I am now done talking about {i}Stump!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我现在讲完{i}树桩{/i}了！

lines.en: : Wakana...you can’t just keep pressuring them like this.
lines.zh: : Wakana……你不能老这么逼他们。

lines.en: : Fine! Then I dare {i}Osako{/i} to kiss {i}me!{/i}
lines.zh: : 好吧！那我敢 {i}Osako{/i} 亲{i}我{/i}！

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk16
: You...do?
: Yeah. Why? You {i}scared?{/i}
lines.zh: : 对啊。怎么？你{i}怕了{/i}？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk17
: We’ve kissed probably ten trillion times. Of course I’m not scared. It’s just a little unlike you to not-
lines.zh: : 我们大概亲过十万亿次了。我当然不怕。只是你居然不——这不太像你。

lines.en: : Drag you into the bathroom first?
lines.zh: : 不先把你拖进卫生间？

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly.
lines.zh: : 对，就是这个。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh! We’ve kissed at the bar before. They’ve seen us. And we can kiss here because they can’t {i}stop{/i} us.
lines.zh: : 才不是！我们在酒吧亲过。她们见过。我们在这儿也能亲，因为她们{i}拦不住{/i}我们。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk18
: I like Wakana’s idea now! I also dare Osako to kiss her! And I’m the king, so you have to do it!
lines.zh: : 我现在喜欢 Wakana 的主意了！我也敢 Osako 亲她！而且我是国王，所以你必须照做！

lines.en: : We’re not playing the God damn King’s Game, Imani! But she’s right. We should make out. Like, together.
lines.zh: : 我们没在玩他妈的国王游戏，Imani！不过她说得对。我们应该舌吻。就是，一起。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk19
: It would be hard to do that alone, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 一个人可很难做到，是吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know, but Imani might since the man she likes refuses to touch her.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，不过 Imani 也许做得到——毕竟她喜欢的那个男人一直不肯碰她。

lines.en: : As the king, I demand that you take that back!
lines.zh: : 作为国王，我命令你收回那句话！

lines.en: : And as the man, I am also not opposed to seeing the two of you make out.
lines.zh: : 而作为那个男人，我也不反对看你们俩舌吻。

lines.en: : Waiting on you, kitten.
lines.zh: : 等你呢，小猫咪。

lines.en: : Is it really okay?...You’re not still mad?
lines.zh: : 真的可以吗？……你不再生气了？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk20
: Mad about what? Whatever did you do, Osako?
lines.zh: : 生什么气？你做了什么吗，Osako？

lines.en: : Have you been {i}disloyal?{/i} Have you {i}slighted{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 你{i}背叛{/i}我了吗？你{i}怠慢{/i}我了吗？

lines.en: : Never...and I don’t know if you’re just way more drunk than I thought, but...earlier in the shower, you said-
lines.zh: : 从来没有……而且我不知道你是不是比我想的醉得厉害，但……刚才洗澡的时候，你说——

lines.en: : For tonight, we shall live in the moment — lest the troubles of the daytime grind these weathered bones to dust.
lines.zh: : 今晚，我们要活在当下——免得白日的烦恼把这两把老骨头碾成齑粉。

lines.en: : Uh...is that, like...{i}from{/i} something?
lines.zh: : 呃……那是……{i}出自{/i}什么典故吗？

lines.en: : My mouth. You might be familiar with it from “that place your tongue is supposed to be.”
lines.zh: : 出自我这张嘴。你也许更熟悉它的另一个版本：「你舌头该待的那个地方」。

lines.en: : You’re ridiculous...
lines.zh: : 你真是荒唐……

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk21
: Chu...
: Boooooo! That ain’t a kiss! That’s-
lines.zh: : 嘘————！这算哪门子亲啊！那是——

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk22
: Ahn~
lines.zh: : 啊嗯~

lines.en: : Oh, okay. That’s better.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。这才像话。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk23
: That’s worse.
lines.zh: : 这更糟了。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk24
: Mmf...mlm...mmnh~
lines.zh: : 唔姆……呣……嗯哼~

lines.en: : Mmnch.......Wakana.....I love you.....
lines.zh: : 呣呜……Wakana……我爱你……

lines.en: : Shut the...fuck up...and keep kissing me!
lines.zh: : 给……我闭嘴……接着亲！

lines.en: : Should we maybe, like...leave them alone for a little while to get whatever this is out of their system?
lines.zh: : 我们是不是该……嗯，先走开一会儿，让她们把这套玩意儿发泄完？

lines.en: : Imani?
lines.zh: : Imani？

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk25
: Uhh...
: Medɔ wo.
lines.zh: : Medɔ wo.（我爱你）

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk26
: I still don’t know what that means.
lines.zh: : 我还是不知道那是什么意思。

lines.en: : Look it up...jerk...
lines.zh: : 自己查去……混蛋……

lines.en: scene black
scene wakanabeachdrunk27
: And with that, my dare has been completed. Hopefully Arakawa has learned something.
lines.zh: : 好了，我的大冒险完成了。希望荒川学到了点东西。

lines.en: : I’ve learned that both of you are very...{i}passionate{/i} kissers but, other than that, not really.
lines.zh: : 我学到了：你们俩接吻都非常……{i}热情{/i}，除此之外就没什么了。

lines.en: : We used to do other things very passionately as well. But alas, this poor broken body just doesn’t do it for Osako anymore.
lines.zh: : 我们以前做别的事也很热情。可惜啊，这副残破的身体现在已经勾不起 Osako 的兴趣了。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk28
: Now, hold on. You know damn well that’s not-
lines.zh: : 等等。你他妈很清楚不是——

lines.en: : I’m not sure {i}what{/i} I know anymore. Both due to the confusion stemming from words we’ve exchanged privately and the fact that I am fucking {i}tweaking{/i} right now.
lines.zh: : 我已经不确定我知道{i}什么{/i}了。一方面是因为我们私下说的那些话把我搞糊涂了，另一方面是因为我现在他妈{i}嗨{/i}着呢。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk29
: So hey, let’s keep daring these two to get it on instead of worrying about me or {i}us.{/i} They won’t be able to refuse if we join together in our verbal assault.
lines.zh: : 所以嘿，我们继续敢他们俩搞到一起去吧，别管我、也别管{i}我们{/i}。要是我们联手嘴炮，他们就拒绝不了。

lines.en: : I’d prefer {i}not{/i} to? I kind of want to talk more about what you just said.
lines.zh: : 我还是{i}别{/i}了吧？我倒想多聊聊你刚才说的那句。

lines.en: : All we’ve fucking done is {i}talk{/i} lately. You’ll have to {i}do{/i} something if your goal here is to {i}sway{/i} me. Especially since words are hard. How many beers do we have left?
lines.zh: : 我们最近他妈净{i}聊天{/i}了。你要是想{i}动摇{/i}我，总得{i}做{/i}点什么吧。尤其「说话」本来就难。我们还剩几瓶啤酒？

lines.en: : Wakana, it’s time to face the facts! Senpai’s {i}never{/i} gonna screw me. I’ve got more of a chance of joining you and Osako for a hot lesbian threesome at this rate.
lines.zh: : Wakana，该面对现实了！前辈{i}永远{/i}都不会睡我。照这个势头，我还不如加入你和 Osako 来场火辣的女同三人行。

lines.en: : Hahah! It’s funny you mention that, because earlier-
lines.zh: : 哈哈！你提这个真巧，因为刚才——

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk30
: Wakana!
lines.zh: : Wakana！

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk31
There’s a moment of silence, but all I can hope is that it’s not the type that succeeds the death of someone or something.
lines.zh: 有一瞬间的沉默，我只能希望它不是那种跟在某个人或某样东西死亡之后的沉默。

lines.en: There are only so many cracks a bowl can handle, you know.
lines.zh: 一只碗能承受的裂缝就那么多，你懂的。

lines.en: : Let’s go for a walk.
lines.zh: : 我们去走走吧。

lines.en: scene wakanabeachdrunk32
: Yes...
: Let’s do that...
lines.zh: : 那就走走吧……

lines.en: scene black
I think I saw tears in her eyes, but I can’t be sure. She was gone too quickly.
lines.zh: 我觉得我看见了她眼里的泪，但我不敢确定。她消失得太快了。

lines.en: That’s how it always works, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 事情总是这样收场的，不是吗？

lines.en: Imani and I remain behind on a beach full of beer cans — a bonfire blazing before us. And as we gaze into it in an attempt to find the right words to break the silence, I wonder if we see the same thing.
lines.zh: Imani 和我留在满是啤酒罐的海滩上——一堆篝火在我们面前燃烧。我们望着火，想找出合适的话打破沉默，而我好奇我们是否看到了同样的东西。

lines.en: We probably do. We {i}normally{/i} do.
lines.zh: 大概是吧。{i}通常{/i}是这样。

lines.en: But she’ll interpret it one way, and I’ll interpret it incorrectly.
lines.zh: 但她会往一个方向理解，而我会理解错。

lines.en: As I detach my eyes from the fire, I remember something...and I immediately hate myself for it.
lines.zh: 当我把目光从火上移开，我想起了一件事……并且立刻为此恨自己。

lines.en: I let my friend get lost at sea.
lines.zh: 我让我的朋友迷失在海上了。

lines.en: The current reeled her in.
lines.zh: 水流把她卷了进去。
